description: This file defines the DiffFormatter class in the Drupal core, responsible for rendering diff outputs as HTML tables with methods for handling diff lines, headers, and context.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Diff\DiffFormatter
classes.description: A class that formats diffs into HTML tables for rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DiffFormatter with configuration settings for context lines.

methods.name: _start_diff
methods.description: Resets the diff rows array at the start of a diff operation.

methods.name: _end_diff
methods.description: Returns the accumulated diff rows at the end of a diff operation.

methods.name: _block_header
methods.description: Generates header data for a diff block.

methods.name: _start_block
methods.description: Starts a new diff block, optionally adding a header.

methods.name: _lines
methods.description: Placeholder for handling lines, currently empty.

methods.name: addedLine
methods.description: Creates a table row for an added line.

methods.name: deletedLine
methods.description: Creates a table row for a deleted line.

methods.name: contextLine
methods.description: Creates a table row for a context (unchanged) line.

methods.name: _changed
methods.description: Handles rendering of changed lines using WordLevelDiff.
